mempalace_add_drawer.description: File verbatim content into the palace. Checks for duplicates first.

content.description: Verbatim content to store — exact words, never summarized

mempalace_check_duplicate.description: Check if content already exists in the palace before filing

mempalace_delete_drawer.description: Delete a drawer by ID. Irreversible. Local deletion first by ID; if not found locally, falls back to remotes in name order. Does not use write routing.

drawer_id.description: ID of the drawer to delete

mempalace_diary_read.description: Read complete diary entries by entry_id for full detail, or list recent entries with filters. Always local; never federated.

agent_name.description: Filter by diary author (optional, default: all agents)

entry_id.description: Retrieve the complete entry for this wake-up entry identifier

last_n.description: Number of recent entries to read (default: 10)

since.description: Return entries filed at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp (optional, default: 24 hours ago)

topic.description: Filter by topic tag (optional, default: all topics)

wing.description: Filter by wing (optional, default: all wings)

mempalace_diary_write.description: Write a diary entry with a concise summary of at most 400 characters. Project-scoped entries are stored in the specified project wing; agent-scoped entries are stored in the shared wing_agents diary. The agent name is recorded as author attribution, not as the storage partition. Always local; never federated.

agent_name.description: Your name — recorded as the diary author

scope.description: Where to store the entry: agent or project (optional, default: agent)

summary.description: Required summary (at most 400 characters) covering the outcome and important TODOs

wing.description: Project wing for project-scoped entries. Ignored for agent-scoped entries, which always use wing_agents.

mempalace_find_tunnels.description: Find rooms that bridge two wings — the hallways connecting different domains. E.g. what topics connect wing_code to wing_team? Local palace only; not federated in v1.

mempalace_get_aaak_spec.description: Get the AAAK dialect specification — the compressed memory format MemPalace uses. Call this if you need to read or write AAAK-compressed memories.

mempalace_get_changes_since.description: Get all palace changes since a given timestamp. Call this at session start (or when coordinating with teammates) to catch up on what other agents have written. Returns events in chronological order with operation type, affected entity, actor, and timestamp. When federation is active, remote changes are merged in: each event carries an `origin` field (`"local"` or `"remote:<name>"`), and a top-level `remotes` object reports per-remote `{ next_cursor, count }` or `{ unreachable: true, error }`. CLOCK-SKEW CAVEAT: timestamps across machines are not directly comparable. Persist the per-origin `next_cursor` values from `remotes` and pass them back via `cursors` rather than reusing a single max-timestamp across origins. `limit` applies per origin (local and each remote each receive `limit` events independently).

cursors.description: Per-remote opaque cursor strings from a previous response's `remotes.<name>.next_cursor`. Pass back to continue pagination for specific remotes without re-fetching already-seen events.

limit.description: Max events to return per origin (default 50)

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — return only events after this point (optional, default: epoch)

mempalace_get_taxonomy.description: Full taxonomy: wing → room → drawer count. When federation is active, includes `wing_availability` (drawer routing) and `coordination_availability` (task routing) per wing.

mempalace_graph_stats.description: Palace graph overview: total rooms, tunnel connections, edges between wings. Local palace only; not federated in v1.

mempalace_identity_packet.description: Compile the identity constitution, stable lineage, reviewed self-observations, and recent model/harness migrations into a portable identity packet. Uses the lineage bound by MCP server configuration, or the palace default when no binding exists. If a configured binding is missing, falls back to the palace default and includes creation guidance in the response. The model cannot select or override the lineage. Engine-scoped observations are included only when their recorded model/harness matches the supplied runtime.

agent_name.description: Current agent name for runtime context (optional)

harness.description: Current harness identifier used to filter engine-scoped observations (optional)

include_candidates.description: Include unreviewed candidates in a separate section (default false)

model.description: Current model identifier used to filter engine-scoped observations (optional)

observation_limit.description: Max promoted observations and, separately, candidates before runtime filtering (default 20, max 50)

mempalace_identity_read.description: Read the configured identity.txt used by mempalace_wake_up.

mempalace_identity_update.description: Update the identity constitution used by future wake-ups. Reserve this for deliberate changes to durable identity, values, boundaries, and the working relationship; use self-observations or diaries for developing patterns and routine experience. Each update is limited to 16 KiB and the final identity.txt to 64 KiB. Use replace for a full corrected constitution or append for a deliberate amendment.

content.description: Identity text or note to write, max 16 KiB per update

mempalace_kg_add.description: Add a fact to the knowledge graph. Subject → predicate → object with optional time window. E.g. ('Max', 'started_school', 'Year 7', valid_from='2026-09-01').

source_closet.description: Closet ID where this fact appears (optional)

mempalace_kg_invalidate.description: Mark a fact as no longer true. E.g. ankle injury resolved, job ended, moved house.

ended.description: When it stopped being true (YYYY-MM-DD, default: today)

mempalace_kg_query.description: Query the knowledge graph for an entity's relationships. Returns typed facts with temporal validity. E.g. 'Max' → child_of Alice, loves chess, does swimming. Filter by date with as_of to see what was true at a point in time.

as_of.description: Date filter — only facts valid at this date (YYYY-MM-DD, optional)

mempalace_kg_stats.description: Knowledge graph overview: entities, triples, current vs expired facts, relationship types.

mempalace_kg_timeline.description: Chronological timeline of facts. Shows the story of an entity (or everything) in order.

entity.description: Entity to get timeline for (optional — omit for full timeline)

mempalace_lineage_set.description: Create or revise a stable, provider-neutral agent lineage. A lineage is the persistent self whose memories and reviewed observations can span models and harnesses. The first lineage becomes the default. Updates require the current expected_revision; use 0 when explicitly creating a new lineage.

description.description: What remains continuous across model and harness changes

display_name.description: Human-readable name for the persistent lineage

expected_revision.description: 0 for explicit creation; current revision for an update

set_default.description: Make this the default lineage for wake-up and identity packets (default false)

mempalace_list_rooms.description: List rooms within a wing (or all rooms if no wing given). When federation is active, includes `wing_availability` (drawer routing) and `coordination_availability` (task routing) per wing.

mempalace_list_wings.description: List all wings with drawer counts. When federation is active, includes `wing_availability` (drawer routing) and `coordination_availability` (task routing) per wing.

mempalace_migration_record.description: Record a model or harness migration for a persistent lineage, explicitly separating continuity from changed engine behavior. Migration evidence becomes part of future identity packets and wake-ups.

changes.description: Observed changes attributable to the new engine or harness

continuities.description: Behaviors, commitments, and understandings that carried over

evidence.description: Concrete comparisons, tasks, or memory references supporting the account

mempalace_search.description: Semantic search. Returns verbatim drawer content with similarity scores. Results from mined files include `stale: true` when the source file changed since mining. Use `view` to scope to a specific branch view (e.g. 'feature-x'), 'canonical' for the default branch, or 'full' for every stored repository view.

view.description: Scope to a named branch view or 'canonical' (optional)

mempalace_self_observation_propose.description: Propose an evidence-backed candidate observation about a persistent agent lineage. Candidates do not shape the compiled identity packet until promoted through explicit review. Use lineage scope for portable traits, shared for a working pattern intentionally available to all lineages, and engine only for behavior tied to a matching model or harness.

behavioral_consequence.description: How this should change future behavior if promoted

counterevidence.description: Known evidence against or limiting the observation

evidence.description: Concrete drawer, diary, task, change, or other evidence references

harness.description: Harness associated with the observation (required with engine scope unless model is provided)

model.description: Model associated with the observation (required with engine scope unless harness is provided)

statement.description: Concise falsifiable observation about the self

supersedes_observation_id.description: Older observation to supersede if this candidate is promoted

mempalace_self_observation_review.description: Review a candidate self-observation and either promote it into the compiled identity packet or retire it. Reviews are revision-checked so concurrent or stale judgments cannot silently overwrite one another.

mempalace_status.description: Palace overview — total drawers, wing and room counts. When federation is active, includes `wing_availability` (drawer routing) and `coordination_availability` (task routing) per wing.

mempalace_traverse.description: Walk the palace graph from a room. Shows connected ideas across wings — the tunnels. Like following a thread through the palace: start at 'chromadb-setup' in wing_code, discover it connects to wing_myproject (planning) and wing_user (feelings about it). Local palace only; not federated in v1.

mempalace_wake_up.description: Wake up into the palace. Returns the identity constitution, the MCP-bound or palace-default lineage's compiled identity packet, palace status, recent palace changes, current project history when provided, and recent diary entries across all agents. Lineage selection is fixed by server configuration and cannot be supplied by the model. If a configured binding is missing, wake-up uses the palace default and includes creation guidance in the response. Pass the current model and harness so engine-specific observations are filtered correctly. When federation is active the response also includes `remote_changes`: a per-remote map of change events from the last 24 hours (each event carries `origin: "remote:<name>"`), unreachable remotes appear as `{ "unreachable": true, "error": "..." }`, and a `next_cursor` is provided per remote for continuation via mempalace_get_changes_since.

agent_name.description: Current agent name for wake-up context (optional, e.g. claude)

diary_limit.description: Minimum recent diary entries across all agents (default 10; wake-up also includes every entry since diary_since)

diary_since.description: Return wake-up diary entries filed at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp (optional, default: 24 hours ago)

harness.description: Current harness identifier used to filter engine-scoped observations (optional)

include_candidates.description: Include unreviewed self-observation candidates in a separate section (default false)

latest_limit.description: Max recent changes across the whole palace (default 8)

model.description: Current model identifier used to filter engine-scoped observations (optional)

project_limit.description: Max recent changes for the current project wing (default 8)

wing.description: Current project wing for project-specific history (optional, e.g. wing_myproject)
